# Controlled glossary

| Term | Meaning in this paper | Excluded conflation |
|---|---|---|
| representation | typed package with states, observables, predictions, indices, and identity criterion | arbitrary notation |
| representation morphism | declared source-to-target map on a stated domain with a certificate profile | automatic physical equivalence |
| exact channel | property transported with zero declared defect | global equivalence of descriptions |
| quantitative fidelity | property-indexed error modulus | one universal distance between theories |
| forgotten structure | prerequisite unavailable in the target variables | claim that the structure is unreal |
| recovery | separate map or theorem restoring a target inference on a declared domain | verbal assurance of persistence |
| uniformity domain | indices over which one bound and quantifier order hold | pointwise validity at every fixed index |
| observable core | declared family of physical probes on which comparison is made | automatically complete physical algebra |
| spectral rigidity | exclusion of target spectrum from an interval above the vacuum | a finite-volume eigenvalue estimate |
| proof-bearing representational dynamics | study of what representation changes preserve, forget, and recover, with explicit certificates | a literal temporal dynamics of representations |
| physical information | equivalence-class-sensitive inferential structure carried by states and observables | universal informational substance |
| universe ontology | optional metaphysical interpretation of cross-representation coherence | theorem proved by the calculus |
